lines.zh: 雪地里，我的爪子一步一个深坑。
lines.en: In the snow, each of my paws leaves a deep print.

lines.zh: 厚厚的毛皮摩擦着灌木
lines.en: Thick fur scrapes through the bushes

lines.zh: 利爪踏过落叶，沙沙作响
用鼻子嗅探周围的气味

lines.en: Flips over its saber bear fur
Licking its saber teeth until they gleam

lines.zh: 厚毛在阳光下晒得暖烘烘
lines.en: Thick fur warming in the sun

lines.zh: 竖起耳朵听着林间动静
lines.en: Ears up, listening to the woods

lines.zh: 剑齿抵着下唇，我转过头。
lines.en: Sabers against my lip, I turn my head.

lines.zh: 我伏低身子，剑齿露在外面。
lines.en: I crouch low, saber teeth bared.
Stares at the player, ready to attack
Prepares to pounce on the player
Approaches the player, ready for combat
Saber teeth bared as a warning

lines.zh: 鼻子抽动，记住你的气味
低吼从喉咙深处滚出来
lines.en: A low growl rolls from deep in its throat

lines.zh: 爪子在地上刨出两道沟
lines.en: Claws carve two grooves in the dirt

lines.zh: 黑影压低身子，准备扑过来
lines.en: The dark shape lowers itself to pounce
Staring at the food in your hand
Planting itself between you and its cub

lines.zh: 这一下打得我前腿一软。
lines.en: That blow buckles my front leg.

lines.zh: 毛皮被划开，我低声咆哮。
lines.en: My pelt is slashed; I growl low.

lines.zh: 它的大獠牙在阳光下闪闪发光。
lines.en: Its big fangs gleam in the sunlight.

lines.zh: 你能否喂饱它那饥饿的肚子？
lines.en: Can you fill its hungry belly?

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着对猎物的渴望。
lines.en: Its eyes sparkle with hunger for prey.

lines.zh: 它会用那锋利的爪子抓住你。
它会用那大嘴咬断你的喉咙。
lines.en: Its big mouth severs your throat.

lines.zh: 它会用那强壮的身躯撞开障碍。
lines.en: Its strong body breaks through obstacles.

lines.zh: 它会用那可怕的叫声吸引你。
它的毛皮在月光下显得格外美丽。
lines.en: Its fur shines beautifully under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 它猛然撞向你，力道惊人。
lines.en: It collides with you with great force.

lines.zh: 它的身体像是铁锤一样撞击。
lines.en: Its body collides like an iron hammer.

lines.zh: 它的力量足以撞倒坚固的墙壁。
lines.en: Its strength can knock down solid walls.
The sound of its collision is shocking.

lines.zh: 它用强壮的身体撞击你。
lines.en: It uses its strong body to collide with you.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞可以震动整个洞穴。
lines.en: Its collision can shake the entire cave.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞力量难以抵挡。
lines.en: Its collision force is hard to resist.

lines.zh: 它的碰撞可以摧毁障碍。
它的碰撞足以击碎石块。
它的碰撞可以击溃你的防线。
lines.en: Its collision can break through your defenses.
It calls its mate with a low growl.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声震颤着地面。
lines.en: Its mating call shakes the ground.

lines.zh: 它会用磨牙声吸引异性。
lines.en: It attracts its mate with grinding noises.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在夜晚回荡。
lines.en: Its mating call echoes at night.
Its mating call pierces the darkness.

lines.zh: 它会用咆哮声寻求伴侣。
lines.en: It seeks a mate with roars.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在寂静中响起。
lines.en: Its mating call sounds in the silence.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声让森林颤栗。
lines.en: Its mating call trembles the forest.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声召唤着同类。
lines.en: Its mating call summons its kind.

lines.zh: 它的求偶声在月光下回响。
lines.en: Its mating call resonates under the moonlight.
Got it! Its fur is so thick!

lines.zh: 皮毛柔软，适合制作衣服。

lines.en: Closer, be wary of its teeth.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中发光。
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 猎物就在溪边低头喝水
lines.en: Prey is drinking at the creek
Followed your scent and found you

lines.zh: 树后有东西在动，追上去
lines.en: Something moves behind the tree. Chase it.
Locked on. You are the one.
This prey will feed it for two days
Its eyes are full of intent.
Saber teeth aimed at your throat
Three steps left before the pounce
Claws pressed into soil, coiling power

lines.zh: 喉咙里的低吼越来越响
lines.en: The growl in its throat grows louder
It circles around to your flank

lines.zh: 呼吸压得极低，等着破绽
lines.en: Breathing low, waiting for an opening

lines.zh: 锋利的爪子撕裂我的皮肉！
lines.en: Sharp claws tear through my flesh!

lines.zh: 咆哮一声，撕开你的喉咙！
lines.en: Roar and tear out your throat!

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，剑齿熊来了！
lines.en: You can't escape, Sabear is here!

lines.zh: 剑齿咬进肩膀，甩都甩不掉
lines.en: Saber teeth sink into your shoulder and hold

lines.zh: 一爪拍下，护甲凹了一块
lines.en: One swipe, and your armor dents

lines.zh: 整个身体压上来，喘不过气
lines.en: Its whole weight bears down, crushing the breath out

lines.zh: 利齿撕开皮肉，血味散开
lines.en: Teeth tear flesh; the smell of blood spreads

lines.zh: 被它一巴掌扇到树干上
lines.en: One slap sends you into a tree trunk

lines.zh: 咬住后腿，把你拖倒在地
lines.en: It bites your leg and drags you down

lines.zh: 黑暗中传来剑齿熊的低吼！
lines.en: Low growls echo in the dark!

lines.zh: 剑齿熊的阴影悄悄逼近！
剑齿熊的咆哮惊醒了寂静！
夜幕下，剑齿熊悄然出现！
我的眼睛能看到你的恐惧！
剑齿熊的踪迹无处不在！
黑暗中，剑齿熊等待着猎物！
剑齿熊的阴影笼罩四周！
黑暗中的剑齿熊，悄无声息！
剑齿熊的吼声划破寂静夜晚！

lines.en: A new scent enters the woods

lines.zh: 一头剑齿熊从灌木后走出来
lines.en: A sabear steps out from the bushes
Heavy fur brushes past the trunk
The growl arrives before the shape

lines.zh: 利爪在树皮上留下记号
lines.en: Claws leave marks on the bark
It appears slowly, crackling over dead leaves
Gnashing teeth echo from a cave

lines.zh: 剑齿熊抬起鼻子嗅了嗅风
lines.en: The sabear lifts its nose and tests the wind

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的獠牙磕在地上。
lines.en: I fell, and my fangs cracked on the ground.
Water chokes me; my fur is soaked through.
Too hungry to even clench my fangs.
